Solution: Added condition in stop() to only save position if currentChunkIndex < chunks.length

Second fix: Added checkLastPosition(isPlaying) call to updateUIFromState() so button updates on every state change
Removed duplicate button visibility control from updateUIFromState():212
checkLastPosition() now accepts isPlaying parameter and always hides button during playback
Complete fix requires both state-manager.js:55 and popup.js:229,344 changes
Third fix: resumeReadingBtn.disabled was set to true in resumeReading():366 but never reset to false on success
Added disabled=false in checkLastPosition():353 when button is shown
Now button is both visible AND enabled after Resume → Stop sequence

name: Read_From_Here_Bug_Fix
observations: Fixed 'Read from here' always starting from beginning instead of selection
Root cause: getSelectionPosition() used document.body while extractPageText() used contentElement (article/main/etc)
Position mismatch when contentElement != body
Solution: Rewrote getSelectionPosition() to use extractPageText() for consistency
Now finds selection position by searching selectedText in fullText using indexOf
File: src/content/content-script.js:307-319
Simplified from 16 lines to 12 lines
Added check for empty selection
Second iteration: Fixed repeated text issue - indexOf would find first occurrence, not actual selection
Final solution: DOM-based position calculation using buildTextNodesMap()

Algorithm: 1) Get range.startContainer and range.startOffset from selection, 2) Build nodeMap of all text nodes, 3) Find startContainer in nodeMap, 4) Calculate position = nodeMap[i].start + range.startOffset
Handles nested nodes by traversing previousSiblings
Now works correctly even when selected text appears multiple times on page
Uses exact DOM position instead of text search

name: Highlight_Overshoot_Bug_Fix
observations: Fixed highlighting extending multiple paragraphs beyond current chunk
Root cause: Complex normalize/search logic in highlightText() caused position mismatches
Old logic: normalize text → indexOf → findOriginalPosition → add searchStart (prone to errors)
New logic: Direct calculation - absoluteStart = extractedTextOffset + startPos, absoluteEnd = extractedTextOffset + endPos
Simplified highlightText() from ~35 lines to ~13 lines
Removed dead code: normalizeText() and findOriginalPosition() functions
File: src/content/content-script.js:195-207
Now provides accurate highlighting without position drift

name: Complete_ContentScript_Refactoring

Old: extractPageText() used contentElement, buildTextNodesMap() used entire document
New: Single source of truth - buildPageContext() returns { contentElement, nodeMap, text }
TreeWalker now scoped to contentElement instead of document
All functions (extractPageText, getSelectionPosition, highlightText) use same buildPageContext()
Eliminated complex normalize/search logic completely
Removed dead code: normalizeText(), findOriginalPosition(), old buildTextNodesMap()
Added proper caching with clearPageContext() on extractText
Simplified highlightText: direct position calculation without text search
Simplified getSelectionPosition: DOM-based with same nodeMap
Result: Guaranteed consistency - same text source, same nodeMap, same positions
File: src/content/content-script.js (complete rewrite)
All 12 tests passing

name: Infinite_Loop_Bug_Fix
observations: Fixed playback looping infinitely at end instead of stopping
Root cause: nextChunk() limited currentChunkIndex to chunks.length - 1
When last chunk finished: handleChunkFinished() called nextChunk(), but index stayed at chunks.length - 1
playNextChunk() check 'currentChunkIndex >= chunks.length' never triggered
Last chunk replayed infinitely
Solution: Changed nextChunk() condition from '< chunks.length - 1' to '< chunks.length'
Now index can reach chunks.length, triggering proper handleStop() in playNextChunk()
File: src/core/state-manager.js:108
One character fix: -1 removed

name: ArchitectureDecisions
observations: Single source of truth: buildPageContext() provides consistent text and nodeMap for all operations
State persistence: lastStopPosition saved only on manual stop, not natural completion
Word-boundary aware: findLogicalStart() aligns selection to sentence boundaries without cutting words
Flexible chunking: MIN=10, MAX=500, DEFAULT_SENTENCES_PER_CHUNK=3
Cache strategy: MAX_CACHE_SIZE=3 (previous + current + next chunks)
Race condition prevention: operationId incrementing pattern
Clean code: Extracted helpers (validatePlaybackData, initializePlayback, handleContextMenuClick)
MutationObserver pattern: Automatically invalidates cached pageContext on DOM changes
Validators module: Pure functions for voice/speed validation, easily testable
Read from selection: Direct substring, no findLogicalStart alignment
Content script audio playback: Works on all browsers including iOS Orion
No Chrome-specific APIs: Ensures cross-browser compatibility
Direct tab messaging: Service worker sends audioData to content script via chrome.tabs.sendMessage
Content script lifecycle: Lives while page is open, perfect for reading books
